nodes.name: Prepare Nexus Input
nodes.notes: For Manual Trigger runs, fill manualInput in this node. Webhook/Form/parent workflows can provide task, project_key, issue_number, and repo_dir on the incoming item instead.

nodes.name: Create Nexus Run
nodes.notes: Creates the durable Nexus run that n8n will advance.

nodes.name: 01 Start triage
nodes.notes: Classify the issue, assign priority, and decide the path

nodes.name: Complete triage
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: Route route_triage
nodes.notes: Evaluates Nexus route rules and writes next_step.

nodes.name: 03 Start design
nodes.notes: Create a design proposal covering API contracts and ADRs

nodes.name: Complete design
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: 04 Start develop
nodes.notes: Implement code changes based on design or triage output

nodes.name: Execute OpenCode develop
nodes.notes: Guarded Nexus endpoint: allowlist, isolated worktree, no push/merge/PR.

nodes.name: 05 Start review
nodes.notes: Review implementation for correctness, quality, and standards; approve only after full regression (or equivalent full CI suite) passes

nodes.name: Complete review
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: Route route_review
nodes.notes: Evaluates Nexus route rules and writes next_step.

nodes.name: 07 Start compliance
nodes.notes: Verify privacy, security, and regulatory compliance

nodes.name: Approval Gate compliance
nodes.notes: Connect this node to an n8n approval/wait mechanism if the gate must pause.

nodes.name: Complete compliance
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: Route route_compliance
nodes.notes: Evaluates Nexus route rules and writes next_step.

nodes.name: 09 Start deploy
nodes.notes: Merge approved PR and create a release

nodes.name: Approval Gate deploy
nodes.notes: Connect this node to an n8n approval/wait mechanism if the gate must pause.

nodes.name: Complete deploy
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: 10 Start close_loop
nodes.notes: Check compliance status, update docs if clear, close issue only if no unresolved blockers

nodes.name: Complete close_loop
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: 11 Start close_rejected
nodes.notes: Post summary and close issues that failed review

nodes.name: Complete close_rejected
nodes.notes: Replace this state transition with a concrete agent/tool call when available.

nodes.name: Switch route_triage
nodes.notes: Routes to the Nexus step selected by the preceding Code node.

nodes.name: Switch route_review
nodes.notes: Routes to the Nexus step selected by the preceding Code node.

nodes.name: Switch route_compliance
nodes.notes: Routes to the Nexus step selected by the preceding Code node.
